executionNotes.expectedFirstFailureMode: Object or parameter naming mismatch against the installed BISON/MOOSE version; resolve against the pinned syntax manual before changing physics.
executionNotes.recommendedFirstPatchAfterCheckInput: If the mechanics action fails on the installed version, temporarily remove the TensorMechanics block and stress materials, then restore mechanics using the version-specific SolidMechanics/TensorMechanics syntax.

notes: The input deck deliberately keeps MCNP/ROCETS mapping data out of BISON top-level syntax.
The BISON file uses a generated RZ ligament mesh so parser and check-input work can start before ntp_rocket.e is QA-reviewed.
Ledinegg, gimbal bleed, control drum, iodine/xenon, and criticality fields are represented as imported state variables for visualization and review; they are not validated fuel material physics.
A validated model requires a bounded validation claim, benchmark data, calibrated materials, mesh QA, code-version pinning, and uncertainty analysis.
